description: A dim, realistic oil-style painting of a large living room at dusk. A glass coffee table is shattered, with shards scattered across a patterned rug. A large dark suitcase or trunk lies on its side near the table, and a cream envelope with cursive handwriting sits on the rug in front of it. Dark leather sofas, bookshelves, a kitchen and tall windows showing bare trees fill the room. No people are visible.
reason: The cream envelope on the rug has visible cursive handwriting, which is letters painted into the image. It is illegible, but it is still writing, so the no_text check needs a human call.
